evidence: The sculpture retains clear surface texture, carved edges, and small cracks, with well preserved bright detail and no meaningful visible defects at this scale.
Mild softness and grain reduce hair, skin, and fabric detail, while the faces and central object remain clear; some bright surfaces lose texture.
Strong directional blur smears bottle edges and label text, while bright glare washes out much of the white bottle; the products remain recognizable but important detail is difficult to inspect.
Soft edges and visible grain reduce fine label and wood detail, while glare obscures a small part of the can label; most printed content remains inspectable.
Strong blur affects the flower center and most petals, preserving the overall shape and colors but removing much of the fine detail from the stamens and petal surfaces.
Hair and facial features remain detailed despite light grain, while a blurred foreground object covers part of the lower torso without obscuring the face.
Large block artifacts and smeared textures reduce detail across produce, faces, and walls; the market scene remains recognizable, but fine features and small text are difficult to inspect.
Produce textures, price cards, and stall edges remain clear, with light grain that has little effect on the main content.
A dense bright veil and reflected glare severely reduce contrast across the frame, leaving the screen and equipment faint and most small details unreadable.
Grass, foliage, building edges, and the truck retain clear detail across the scene, with readable larger signs and no meaningful visible defects at this scale.
